6.2.2.2.5 NVRAM Manager
Detection
Depending on the stack configuration:
 Polling of the job result MEMIF_JOB_FAILED by the function
MemIf_GetJobResult (see Memory Abstraction Interface above).
 Notification by FEE with the callback function
NvM_JobErrorNotification (see Flash Eeprom emulation above).
Reaction
If write processing involved :
[SWS_NvM_00213] [SWS_NvM_00296] Increment write retry counter.
If the number of retries is exceeded, the request is aborted.
Report
 [SWS_NvM_00271] [SWS_NvM_00269] The error
NVM_E_REQ_FAILED is reported to the DEM.
 The error can is available by polling the NVRAM Manager with the
function NvM_GetErrorStatus (job result set to
NVM_REQ_NOT_OK).
Recovery
If write processing involved :
[SWS_NvM_00168] [SWS_NvM_00213] [SWS_NvM_00296] The
NVRAM Manager controls the error recovery mechanism. The
Description of the AUTOSAR standard errors
recovery mechanism is (if configured) “write retry”.
